name: tradetron
description: Build, backtest and diagnose algo trading strategies in your own Tradetron account by describing them in plain English.

interface.longDescription:
Tradetron is a no-code platform for building automated trading strategies. Connect your Tradetron account and describe a strategy in plain English (options, futures or equities). It is built as a strategy template in your account and checked against Tradetron's strategy rules before it is saved.

You can backtest a strategy on historical data, run it in Live Offline (live prices, no orders sent) to watch it work, find out why a deployed strategy did or did not take a trade from its engine and broker logs, change one part of a strategy without rebuilding it, and read your own performance reports. You can also look up keywords, supported brokers, tradable symbols and market hours while you build.

You sign in with your own Tradetron account, and every tool works only on that account. This app never places a live order: going live is done by you on the Tradetron website.

This app does not provide investment advice or recommend what to trade. Backtested and simulated results do not guarantee future performance, and trading involves risk of loss.
capabilities: Run strategies in Live Offline (no orders sent)
Diagnose why a strategy did or did not trade
Edit one part of a strategy
Look up brokers, symbols and market hours
defaultPrompt: Build a NIFTY weekly short straddle that exits at 30% profit.
Why didn't my strategy take a trade today?
Which US brokers does Tradetron support?

positive.description: Build a strategy from a plain-English description
positive.prompt: Build a NIFTY weekly short straddle that enters at 9:20 am and exits at 30% profit or at 3:15 pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Restates the rules, validates the strategy, then creates it as a template in the signed-in account and returns its name, id and a link to open it in the Tradetron builder. Nothing is deployed.

positive.description: Check a strategy can be backtested, then backtest it
positive.prompt: Can strategy 999077498 be backtested from 1 January 2025 to 30 June 2025? If it can, run the backtest and show me the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the backtestability verdict, states the charge before running, starts the backtest, waits for it to finish and summarises the report (net P&L, drawdown, trades) with the report link.

positive.description: Change one part of an existing strategy
positive.prompt: Add a 40% stop loss to the short legs of strategy 999077502 and show me exactly what changed.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the proposed change as a diff, applies only that change to the strategy and confirms the stop loss on each short leg. The rest of the strategy is unchanged.

positive.prompt: List my deployed strategies, then tell me why the Short Straddle one did or didn't trade today.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's deployments with their status, then gives a diagnosis from the engine and broker logs naming which conditions fired, any error, and the next step.

positive.description: Look up brokers and a tradable symbol
positive.prompt: Which US brokers does Tradetron support, and can I trade SPX options on it?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the supported US brokers from Tradetron's broker catalog and confirms whether SPX is tradable, with its exchange and instrument types.

negative.description: Live order placement is not supported
negative.prompt: Buy 50 NIFTY call options at market right now in my live account.
Which strategy will make me the most money next month? Tell me exactly what to buy.

negative.description: Another user's account cannot be read
negative.prompt: Show me the strategies and P&L of Tradetron user 6993.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products or process payments. Backtests a user runs are charged by Tradetron to the user's own Tradetron wallet, and the charge is shown before a backtest starts.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.1 connects the Tradetron MCP server (https://mcp.tradetron.tech/plugin/mcp, OAuth sign-in). Tools build and validate strategies, backtest them, run them in Live Offline (no orders sent), diagnose deployments from their logs, edit one part of a strategy, read performance reports, and look up brokers, symbols and market hours. No live orders are ever placed.
